decision: Fire water is fresh water: the 2 x 100 % fire water tanks (2 x 700 m3) are filled from the SWRO permeate tank by a dedicated fill line with an air gap; one tank is refilled within 10 h with both SWRO trains in operation (2 x 32 m3/h plus the permeate tank), the other tank holds the full 2 h design demand meanwhile (accepted by the Owner's insurer, TQ-041). No seawater is admitted to the fire water system; bronze-fitted fire pumps, deluge valves and foam proportioners are therefore acceptable.
rationale: Fresh-water fire protection avoids seawater corrosion of the fire main and sprinkler / deluge systems; the second full tank covers the refill time beyond the 8 h of NFPA 850.
title: Fire water source and refill
